name: Dai Ming
bio:
Known for “Learn iOS Programming with Dai Ming” and “GeekTime’s iOS Development Master Course", Dai Ming has driven iOS performance at top companies like Kuaishou, Alibaba, and Didi. From mastering compilation to optimizing every detail on iOS and macOS, his insights are a game-changer.

Catch Dai Ming at iOSConfSG - this is one session you won’t want to miss.
